nodes.description: External caller address; reused as owner, spender, whitelist subject and balance key across the token.
Privileged owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and whitelists transfers.
Public mapping of holder balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested allowance mapping; decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Private per-address counter of recent sale transfers, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private whitelist allowing bypass of the sale condition check in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount set by init with an unchecked multiplication.
Private maximum sale amount set by init with an unchecked multiplication.
Private number of allowed sale transfers per address, set by init and read by condition.
Public total supply minted to the deployer.
Private trading address whitelisted in ensure; settable only by owner.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure.
Constant 18-decimal scaling factor used in unchecked multiplications.
Public token name set by the constructor.
Public token symbol set by the constructor.
Public payable entrypoint that forwards the call to transferFrom with msg.sender as the sender.
Public payable transfer routine: spends allowance, calls ensure, mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic and emits Transfer.
Internal whitelist gate: lets owner, Uniswap pair/address, tradeAddress and canSale addresses pass, otherwise requires condition.
Public payable approval that unconditionally overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) with user-supplied target and calldata.
Mint function restricted to owner or a hardcoded address; overwrites balanceOf[spender] using unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos and using unchecked multiplication and subtraction on balances.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address from factory and tokens via keccak256.
Payable constructor minting the full supply to msg.sender, setting owner, metadata and unlimited router allowance.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) that executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in the context of this contract.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) in _mints.
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.
Unchecked multiplication maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init.
Unchecked multiplication _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) in the constructor.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Sender parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, drives unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Spender parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate, used as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter of delegate, used as the delegatecall payload.
Beneficiary parameter of _mints.
Amount parameter of _mints, multiplied unchecked by 10**decimals.
Sale count parameter of init.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init, scaled unchecked.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init, scaled unchecked.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend, length used in unchecked multiplication.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Sender parameter of ensure.
Recipient parameter of ensure.
Amount parameter of ensure, forwarded to condition.
Local total amount computed in batchSend.
Loop index of the batchSend distribution loop.
Loop-local recipient inside batchSend.
Local computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure.
